title: Episode 117: Starvation, Betrayal, and the Turn Against the Hills

blocks.text: The trapped survivors discover that the hills are no refuge. Men who descend are hunted, those who remain above are encircled, and hunger becomes as deadly as the enemy because food cannot be secured anywhere in safety.

The strongest emotional note on the page is betrayal by the hill chiefs. The Singhs reflect that they had fought Mughal power in ways that also benefited the hill rulers, yet the same chiefs now help tighten the noose instead of offering shelter.

Out of that anger and desperation the survivors harden themselves again. Rather than die passively, they turn back toward the mountains, striking where they can and trying to force a path through a region that has already decided against them.
